title: Reflect non-blocking — edge-flywheel timeout
problem: reflect.sh blocks on edge-flywheel detect-dirty-scope under dirty trees; piping to tail hides progress; lesson append wrongly waited on flywheel.

solution.summary: Make edge-flywheel post-hook best-effort with timeout; always finish reflect report; document lesson-append independence.
steps: Wrap edge-flywheel invocation in timeout (perl/python alarm 120s on macOS) ; on timeout append aborted note and exit 0 for reflect.
Echo progress lines to stderr so tee|tail does not silence mid-run forever if using `stdbuf` or unbuffered writes before flywheel.
Update skill text: lesson append independent of reflect completion.
verify: SKIP_EDGE_FLYWHEEL=1 bash reflect.sh completes <60s and writes new reflect-*.md
Forced hang simulation: timeout path writes aborted note

acceptance_probe: reflect exits 0 within 60s with SKIP_EDGE_FLYWHEEL=1; lessons appendable without flywheel.
